description: This file defines the PrayerTimesRepository class responsible for fetching, caching, and providing prayer times data from the Aladhan API. It manages network requests, local caching via SharedPreferences, and processes the response into PrayerTimes objects. It also offers a method to retrieve current calculation settings.

classes.name: PrayerTimesRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing fetching and caching of prayer times.

classes.name: PrayerTimesWithSource
classes.description: Data class combining PrayerTimes with the source (NET or CACHE).

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Data class representing prayer time calculation settings.

classes.name: Source
classes.description: Enum class indicating data source: NETWORK or CACHE.

methods.name: getPrayerTimesForDate
methods.description: Fetches prayer times for a specific date and location, with cache fallback.

methods.name: toPrayerTimes
methods.description: Converts API response to PrayerTimes data object.

methods.name: cachePrayerTimes
methods.description: Stores prayer times in cache and manages cache invalidation.

methods.name: lastCachedDateKey
methods.description: Generates cache key for last cached date.

methods.name: cacheKey
methods.description: Generates cache key based on settings and date.

methods.name: settingsKey
methods.description: Constructs a key string based on prayer times settings.

methods.name: safeKey
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be safe for use as a preferences key.

methods.name: currentSettings
methods.description: Returns current prayer times calculation settings.
